notes: Tutorial-adjacent Personal Arc beat. Fires on first week — Petra Solis (aide to Majority Whip Audrey Vance) approaches the player to 'orient' them. Real purpose: the Whip is taking the measure of the new senator before committing any calendar or political resource. Two choice points: (1) how the player reads the subtext of the opening — tests tone archetype (diplomatic / aggressive / naive / savvy); (2) how the player signals their faction lean when pressed. Faction IDs 'reform-bloc' and 'establishment-wing' are authoring placeholders — TODO(vex): align faction IDs with Nova's FactionSystem spec (M2). Effect kind 'faction-standing' is a proposed new DialogueEffect kind not yet in the §3.4 union — TODO(vex): Sol to confirm implementation path before this tree ships; see intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md OQ-A. NPC 'petra-solis' is a new character not present in the §12.3.4 named seed list; needs a character entry in docs/wiki/ and scenario legislators data. See intro-aide-dialogue-notes.md for full authoring rationale, faction delta intent, and schema questions.

open.speaker: npc
open.text: Senator {pc.name}. Petra Solis — I'm with the Majority Whip's office.

open-b.speaker: npc
open-b.text: She asked me to orient new arrivals. That's the explanation she'd give anyone.

options.label: The Whip doesn't do courtesy calls. What does she want?
I appreciate it. Still finding my footing.
You're her field reader, not her scheduler. I've done my homework.
options.failureHint: Requires Connections 3. You haven't mapped the Capitol yet.

read-room.speaker: npc
read-room.text: The unofficial reason is the Whip likes to know who's navigable before she needs them to be.

read-room-guarded.speaker: npc
read-room-guarded.text: She wants to know if you're useful or expensive. Most freshmen are both.

read-room-soft.speaker: npc
read-room-soft.text: You'll find it. I'd work quickly — the first month sets the terms everyone forgets they set.

read-room-impressed.speaker: npc
read-room-impressed.text: My file says you've been talking to people. That's either smart or a tell. I haven't decided which.

faction-reveal.speaker: npc
faction-reveal.text: The Reform Bloc and the Establishment Wing aren't at war. They're deciding whether to be.

faction-choice.speaker: npc
faction-choice.text: You're new enough that neither side has claimed you. The Whip wants to know which way you're leaning.

options.label: Tell her I'm interested in what the Reform Bloc is building.
Tell her I don't lean until I know the terrain.
I've already spoken with Elbe. The Whip can draw her own conclusions.
options.failureHint: The Reform Bloc doesn't know you well enough for this to land.

petra-align-reform.speaker: npc
petra-align-reform.text: I'll pass that along. The Bloc is organized and it remembers favors. It also remembers the absence of them.

petra-neutral.speaker: npc
petra-neutral.text: Then read the terrain fast. The undecided don't stay valuable for long.

petra-align-bloc-warned.speaker: npc
petra-align-bloc-warned.text: Senator Elbe. You're leading with that name in front of me. That's a choice.

exit-cold.speaker: npc
exit-cold.text: We'll be in touch, Senator. Everyone is.

exit.speaker: narrator
exit.text: Petra Solis disappears into the corridor traffic.
